plan.notes: Parsed 2026-10-02 from the official Sacramento State 2026-2027 Catalog 'BA in Political Science and Journalism' page 4-Year Roadmap Plan of Study Grid. Semester unit totals verified against the catalog's printed semester totals and the printed Total Units figure. GE-area and 'Elective of Choice' placeholder rows are seeded as choice slots (any course fulfilling the area). Catalog 'A or B' rows are seeded as choice slots with the first-listed code. The catalog grid publishes no prerequisite column; prereq arrays are empty. A separate 2-Year Roadmap for transfer students is also published on the page and is not seeded. NOTE: the catalog publishes a second, different 4-Year Roadmap for this same program name on the College of Arts & Letters Journalism department page (119 units), seeded separately as 'csus-ba-political-science-journalism-arts-letters'.
